ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: DooTask needs access to your camera to scan QR codes, take photos, and join video meetings.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: DooTask needs access to your microphone to record voice messages and join audio and video meetings.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: DooTask needs access to your photo library so you can view recent photos and select and send photos or videos.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: DooTask needs permission to add photos or videos to your photo library so you can save them.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: DooTask needs your location while you use the app so you can check in by location.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: DooTask needs access to your local network to connect to servers deployed on your LAN.
